n1.chat.entlassung.text: Dismissal prepared: {rolle} {name}. Nothing happens until you choose a successor below.
n1.chat.entlassung.why: A dismissal costs capital, angers the person's camp and moves the markets for finance and industry. The card shows every consequence before you decide.
n1.chat.entlassung.wen: Whom? Name the office or the surname, for example “Entlasse den Gesundheitsminister”. Before any dismissal you see the consequences and three candidates.

n1.chat.folge.gesetz: {n, plural, one {One bill goes} other {# bills go}} to parliament

n1.chat.vorschlag.geaendert: The price has changed: now {neu, number} instead of {alt, number} capital. Please check the proposal again.
n1.chat.karte.meldung: Afterwards the presidential office would report:
n1.chat.karte.entlassung.weg: This person is no longer in office.
n1.chat.ki.willkommen: You have the floor, in your own words. I know where your game stands, explain how things connect and suggest steps for you to confirm. Nothing that costs capital happens without your sign-off.
